params.name: email
params.description: Filter plans by the donor's email address.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Filter plans started on or after this date. Accepted formats: YYYY-mm-dd, YYYY/mm/dd, YYYYmmdd, dd-mm-YYYY.

params.name: date_to
params.description: Filter plans started on or before this date. Accepted formats: YYYY-mm-dd, YYYY/mm/dd, YYYYmmdd, dd-mm-YYYY.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: Filter plans by Donorbox campaign id.

params.name: donor_id
params.description: Filter plans by Donorbox donor id.

params.name: first_name
params.description: Filter plans by donor first name.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Filter plans by donor last name.

params.name: donor_name
params.description: Filter plans by donor full name (equivalent to combining first_name and last_name).

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records per page. Default 50, maximum 100 (values above 100 fall back to the default).

items.docs: Returns all recurring donation plans (subscriptions) for the authenticated organization. Endpoint and response shape confirmed in the official README sample payload.
